drops.eligibility: Any ONE of: held at least 500 “Final Nuts” at the Apr 25, 2026, 02:00 UTC snapshot; cast at least one vote in a Season 2 governance poll; hold a Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT. Wallets flagged in the Sybil check receive less or nothing.
drops.name: Treehouse
drops.notes: No DM links: Treehouse says it does not send claim links by direct message. 07:00 UTC Nov 25 is 2:00 a.m. Eastern — in practice, Tuesday night is your deadline.
steps: Open the Season 2 claim on the gaiafoundation.xyz portal linked from Treehouse's own site and docs.
Connect the same wallet you used in the campaign.
Claim once — anything unclaimed after Nov 25, 07:00 UTC returns to the treasury. 23.1 million TREE; the 180-day linear release finished Oct 26, so claiming now pays the full allocation at once.

drops.eligibility: You must have registered a Base address by July 30, 2026. Registration is closed — this cannot be farmed now.
drops.name: Doppler Finance
drops.notes: Genesis airdrop claim ends Sat Nov 28, 12:00 UTC.
steps: Open the Doppler claim portal from the project's official site.
Connect the registered Base wallet — another address will not work; the allocation is tied to it.
Claim before Nov 28, 12:00 UTC. Unclaimed allocations expire. 100 million XDP — 1% of the 10 billion total supply. Fully unlocked, no vesting.

drops.eligibility: Stage 6 “Convergence”: only for participants who chose the full-allocation (100% vested) option back in April. That choice can no longer be changed. Took the half payout in spring? This window is not yours.
drops.name: Aster
steps: Connect the wallet you used in April.
Claim before Dec 4, 12:00 UTC. 64M ASTER in Stage 6.

drops.eligibility: Glacier Drop: Cardano's privacy-focused partner chain. Allocation arrives in four instalments, 25% each, 90 days apart.
drops.name: Midnight
steps: Check the portal at midnight.gd — unclaimed instalments show a countdown to the next release.
Thaw ends Dec 4, then a 90-day grace period.

drops.eligibility: Season 1. Claim window opened Nov 18 at 09:00 UTC, 30-day window. Pick BEFORE you claim: A — Instant unlock, 35% now, you forfeit the other 65%; B — Vesting, 100% later after staking for 12 months. No choice? You get B by default.
drops.name: Predict.fun
drops.notes: The vesting choice is the whole decision.
steps: Claim only at the airdrop page on predict.fun itself.
Confirm the live status on predict.fun before you act — some roundups reported a postponement.

drops.eligibility: Based on pre-deposits, mainnet volume, market making and referrals, with Sybil screening. Token launch cancelled, so rewards are paid in the DUSD stablecoin — one payment, no lockup.
drops.name: StandX
steps: Claim with the same wallet, on BNB Chain or Solana, only on the StandX website.
Claim before Dec 31, 08:00 UTC. Open since Nov 2.

drops.name: Grass — Stage 2
steps: Claim in USDC through the Grass dashboard.
Window ends Jan 22, 2027 — or sooner if all allocations are claimed first. Do not leave it to January.

fakes_busted.name: Hyperliquid “Season 2”
fakes_busted.note: Not real. No Season 2, no snapshot, no points program announced. Points ended Nov 2024; the only HYPE airdrop was genesis on Nov 29, 2024. Prediction markets put a second airdrop in 2026 at roughly 5%. Any “Season 2 claim” link is a scam.

fakes_busted.name: MetaMask “MASK” drop
fakes_busted.note: Not real either. A Nov 26 deadline and Nov 12 opt-in are circulating, but MetaMask's own pages say Season 1 of Rewards ended in early 2026, the claim window is closed, and there are no plans for a MASK token.

farm_now.name: Monad
farm_now.note: Points only at this stage. Watchlist — do not pay fees chasing it.

farm_now.name: LayerZero v2
farm_now.note: Points only at this stage. Watchlist — do not pay fees chasing it.

intro: Three claim windows close in the next six days, and two of the most-shared “airdrops” online right now are not real. Work down the deadline board in date order. Every deadline is UTC. This is information, not financial advice. Rewards are never guaranteed. Airdrop Lookout lists eligibility rules, deadlines and steps. You check your own wallet yourself. We never ask for your wallet address, seed phrase or private key — and neither does any legitimate project.

just_closed.name: Fables (FABLES)
just_closed.note: Points claim + PROLOGUE redemption closed Fri Nov 20, 23:59 UTC. Unclaimed FABLES will not be minted later. Be wary of any “late claim” site that appears now — that pattern is a common drainer setup.

checklist: Turn on app-based 2FA on your email, exchange and social accounts. An authenticator app beats SMS and email codes.
Bookmark the official pages for Treehouse, Doppler, Aster and Midnight now — then only ever claim from those bookmarks.
Claim with the wallet that earned the allocation, then move rewards out. Do not keep your main funds in a wallet you connect everywhere.
Revoke old token approvals you no longer need. Stop on unlimited approvals or a signature you cannot explain.
safety.myth_buster: “A real claim might ask for my seed phrase to verify me.” False — always. No legitimate project, support team or claim page ever needs your seed phrase or private key. The moment a site asks for one, close it.
red_flags: DM and reply links for Treehouse, Hyperliquid “Season 2” or a MetaMask MASK claim
“Claim in 10 minutes or lose it” pressure
Being asked to send funds first to “unlock” a reward
Lookalike domains — extra letters, hyphens or a different ending, not on the official page
safety.thirty_second_rule: Tick each one before you connect a wallet: start from the official website or verified account — never a DM; read what you are about to sign; never enter a seed phrase or private key — no legitimate claim needs one; never switch wallets to move eligibility — Sybil screening flags it.

safety_tip: Deadline weeks are when drainers work hardest. The closer a real claim gets to closing, the more fake copies of it appear. The 30-second rule: start from the project's official website or verified account — never a DM — read what you are about to sign, and if anything feels rushed, close the tab and check again later. A real deadline is on the official page, not in a DM.
